1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David. May the Lord answer you when you are in trouble; may the God of Jacob make you secure.

2.w: May he send you help from his temple; from Zion may he give you support.

3.w: May he take notice of all your offerings; may he accept your burnt sacrifice. (Selah)

4.w: May he grant your heart’s desire; may he bring all your plans to pass.

5.w: Then we will shout for joy over your victory; we will rejoice in the name of our God. May the Lord grant all your requests.

6.w: Now I am sure that the Lord will deliver his chosen king; he will intervene for him from his holy, heavenly temple, and display his mighty ability to deliver.

7.w: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we depend on the Lord our God.

8.w: They will fall down, but we will stand firm.

9.w: The Lord will deliver the king; he will answer us when we call to him for help!
